commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install aide =="
sudo -n dnf install -y aide

echo "== STEP 2: configure aide.conf for /etc integrity baseline =="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/aide.conf /etc/aide.conf.orig
if ! grep -q '^/etc' /etc/aide.conf; then
  echo "/etc FIPSR" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/aide.conf >/dev/null
fi
grep -n '^/etc' /etc/aide.conf || true

echo "== STEP 3: initialize baseline database =="
sudo -n aide --init --config=/etc/aide.conf

echo "== STEP 4: activate baseline db =="
sudo -n ls -l /var/lib/aide/
sudo -n cp -a /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
sudo -n ls -l /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz

echo "== STEP 5: checksum + timestamp the baseline for record-keeping =="
sudo -n sha256sum /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz.sha256
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/baseline-established.txt

echo "== STEP 6: run a check against the freshly established baseline (expect clean) =="
sudo -n aide --check --config=/etc/aide.conf || AIDE_CHECK_RC=$?
echo "aide check exit code: ${AIDE_CHECK_RC:-0}"

echo "== DONE =="
